notes: Packet 12 decision follow-up. A: the Shabbat Morning 'Sim Shalom' 5b76564f is a separate graphic. Compared revision 1 (draft v1) with draft v2: same source id and pins (unit b428e916..., blocks 0-2 hashes identical), same block selection for he and tr, same title 'Sim Shalom - שִׂים שָׁלוֹם', same name, no accent title in either, same layout and template, identical rendered texts. The only changes are content.arrangement 'blocks' and presentation.latinLineBreaks 'paragraphs', so v2 is style-only and was published. B: Sim Shalom 1-4 took the shared defaults via style_draft (arrangement blocks, comfortableTypography, latinLineBreaks paragraphs). The dry-run showed sourcePreserved true on all four, and the compact/26/22 overrides were dropped on 3 and 4. All four passed fit at comfortable size and read well, so all four were published. The fallback (keep arrangement 'together' with comfortable type) was not needed. Each panel now shows one Hebrew paragraph followed by one matching transliteration paragraph instead of line-by-line alternation. Source observations carried forward unchanged (not edited): 1-3 repeat the 'Sim shalom ... amecha' refrain, the transliteration has a bracketed '[v'al]' in 1-3, and Sim Shalom 4 repeats 'tovim ulshalom.' and its last transliteration line lacks the final period. The 'תְּפִלָּה' accent on 1-4 is kept as the shared Amidah label.

history.notes: Packet 12, DECISION family, not changed. (1) 'Sim Shalom' 5b76564f is a CRC Shabbat Morning (legacy-shabbat-morning) bottom graphic, a different source and service from the RH-morning Sim Shalom 1-4. It looks like a separate graphic, not a part, so the mixed-layout concern is probably a false grouping. Its current version 2 (blocks + latinLineBreaks paragraphs) is unpublished (active 1); fit passes at fill 0.567 and the image reads well, so it could be published if the v1->v2 diff is confirmed style-only. (2) Sim Shalom 1-4 (crc-rh-morning:amidah.sim-shalom, sequential non-overlapping blocks 1-6/7-14/15-22/23-27) are all left panels with line-by-line alternating he/tr rows; 3 and 4 carry smallFont (compact, he 26/tr 22). All pass fit at their current versions. The queue suggests converting to arrangement blocks with comfortable type, but the line-by-line alternation reads well for this sung piece. Sim Shalom 2 at the default size already fills 0.959, so Sim Shalom 3 (8 blocks) at comfortable size may be at the overflow edge. (3) The 'tefilah' accent on 1-4 is the generic Amidah label shared with Zochreinu 'Remember Us'; not a mismatch. (4) Source observations: 1-3 each repeat the 'Sim shalom ... amecha' refrain (distinct source blocks, so the RH source itself repeats it); the transliteration has a bracketed '[v'al]' in 1-3; Sim Shalom 4 repeats 'tovim ulshalom.' and its last transliteration line lacks the final period.
